title.narrative: Social Security Coverage expanded

description.narrative: Social Security Coverage expanded

comment.narrative: The Royal Government of Cambodia commits to achieve universal health coverage in 2030. The Ministry of Health estimates that the existing health coverage schemes including the HEF and schemes managed by NSSF can collectively cover about 4.7 million Cambodians or 30 of the population According to the National Health Strategic Plan 20162020 the country aims to increase the coverage to 8.12 million or 50 of the population by 2020.
At least 150000 additional people are under health coverage.
